promotion.primary_job: turn useful signals into finished work
promotion.primary_differentiator: selects useful context and completes a workflow

strategy.category_default: more notifications and more generated output mean more value
strategy.deleted_constraint: the user needs another source of noise
strategy.new_competition_axis: useful signal converted into an outcome
strategy.bridge: a noisy flock represents endless notifications while one clear original bird call becomes the useful signal that triggers completed work

beats.scene: A fictional social-native frame shows many original stylized notification birds all chirping at once around an overwhelmed desk.
beats.caption: 再多一个提醒，会更有用吗？

beats.scene: The flock gets denser while unfinished generic work cards pile up.
beats.caption: 信息更多，事情没少。

beats.scene: One distinct small bird lands beside the single genuinely useful note; Signal Tool connects that note to a finished document.
beats.caption: 有用的，是这一声。

beats.scene: The noisy flock recedes into the background while the completed work is foregrounded.
beats.caption: 不是再多一个声音，是把对的声音变成结果。

concept.genre_treatment: original social-native documentary realism with light surreal bird metaphor and anonymous people
punchlines: 不是再多一个声音，是把对的声音变成结果。
concept.image_prompt: Original four-beat social-native scene with anonymous people and stylized fictional birds representing notification noise; one useful bird call is connected to completed work by the promoted tool; documentary-real social framing, no copied social UI or creator likeness.
concept.negative_prompt: No TikTok or platform UI, no real creator faces, no copied meme template, no unsupported claims about user behavior.
risk_flags: Treat the social-noise observation as metaphor, not a universal behavioral claim.
